subject.title: fix: QA package builds support unreleased versions

question: Should scheduled/live, plugin prerelease, installer, Parallels, Bun, and local Docker QA packages opt into the canonical unreleased-changelog fallback?
rationale: Current main already fixes QA smoke, while this PR deliberately broadens the fallback policy across additional automation surfaces and carries the protected `maintainer` label.

options.title: Extend QA-only callers
options.body: Rebase onto the canonical flag and retain the broader current-tree QA callers with complete rerun-state preservation.

options.title: Keep fallback smoke-only
options.body: Drop the additional callers if those workflows should remain strict until an exact changelog section exists.

recommendation.title: Extend QA-only callers
recommendation.body: Rebase onto the canonical flag and retain the broader current-tree QA callers with complete rerun-state preservation.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is assigned to this person, and their history covers both the underlying package tooling and the proposed broader policy boundary.
